**Note**: You may use available tools or skills in the system to complete this task.

and you need to complete the task in 480s.

- Securities Market

- Market capitalisation was $49.9 trillion at the end of February 2026, an increase of 28 per cent from $39.1 trillion for the same period last year.

- The average daily turnover in February 2026 was $246.8 billion.

- The average daily turnover for the first two months of 2026 was $260.9 billion, an increase of 17 per cent when compared with $222.5 billion for the same period last year.

- The average daily turnover of derivative warrants for the first two months of 2026 was $7.7 billion, an increase of 28 per cent when compared with $6.0 billion for the same period last year.

- The average daily turnover of CBBCs for the first two months of 2026 was $13.7 billion, an increase of 54 per cent when compared with $8.9 billion for the same period last year.

- The average daily turnover of ETFs for the first two months of 2026 was $35.2 billion, an increase of 11 per cent when compared with $31.7 billion for the same period last year.

- There were 24 newly listed companies for the first two months of 2026, an increase of 140 per cent when compared with 10 for the same period last year.

- Funds raised through IPOs# for the first two months of 2026 was $89.2 billion, an increase of 1015 per cent when compared with $8.0 billion for the same period last year.

- Total funds raised for the first two months of 2026 was $123.4 billion, an increase of 331 per cent when compared with $28.6 billion for the same period last year.

- Derivatives Market

- The average daily volume of futures and options for the first two months of 2026 was 1,718,637 contracts.

- The average daily volume of equity index options for the first two months of 2026 was 150,570 contracts, an increase of 12 per cent when compared with the 134,064 contracts for the same period last year.

- On 4 February 2026, the volume of Hang Seng TECH Index Futures Options reached a record high of 208,378 contracts.

- Securities Market

- Market capitalisation was $35.4 trillion at the end of January 2025, an increase of 26 per cent from $28.1 trillion for the same period last year.

- The average daily turnover in January 2025 was $143.8 billion, an increase of 49 per cent from $96.7 billion for the same period last year.

- The average daily turnover of CBBCs in January 2025 was $7.1 billion, an increase of 11 per cent when compared with $6.4 billion for the same period last year.

- The average daily turnover of ETFs in January 2025 was $21.2 billion, an increase of 94 per cent when compared with $10.9 billion for the same period last year.

- The average daily turnover of L&I Products in January 2025 was $2.6 billion, an increase of 4 per cent when compared with $2.5 billion for the same period last year.

- There were 8 newly listed companies in January 2025, an increase of 60 per cent when compared with 5 for the same period last year.

- Funds raised through IPOs# in January 2025 was $5.7 billion, an increase of 159 per cent when compared with $2.2 billion for the same period last year.

- Derivatives Market

- The average daily volume of futures and options in January 2025 was 1,452,108 contracts.

- The average daily volume of Stock Options in January 2025 was 759,565 contracts, an increase of 17 per cent when compared with 649,510 contracts for the same period last year.

- The average daily volume of RMB Currency Futures in January 2025 was 115,142 contracts, an increase of 49 per cent when compared with 77,417 contracts for the same period last year.
